definitions.explanation: The state of combustion producing heat and light.

examples.japanese: {寒|さむ}いので{火|ひ}を{起|お}こして{暖|あたた}まった。
examples.english: It was cold, so I started a fire and warmed up.

examples.japanese: {火|ひ}の{用心|ようじん}を{忘|わす}れないで、{寝|ね}る{前|まえ}にガスの{火|ひ}を{確認|かくにん}しよう。
examples.english: Don't forget fire safety — let's check the gas before going to bed.

examples.japanese: キャンプで{火|ひ}を{起|お}こすのは{難|むずか}しかったが、みんなで{協力|きょうりょく}してやっと{火|ひ}がついた{時|とき}はとても{嬉|うれ}しかった。
examples.english: Starting a fire at the campsite was difficult, but when we all worked together and finally got it lit, we were very happy.

examples.japanese: ろうそくの{火|ひ}が{消|き}えた。
{火|ひ}を{弱|よわ}くしてください。
ろうそくの{火|ひ}が{風|かぜ}でゆらゆら{揺|ゆ}れている。
examples.english: The candle flame is flickering in the breeze.

examples.japanese: ガスの{火|ひ}を{強|つよ}くして{早|はや}くお{湯|ゆ}を{沸|わ}かしたいのに、なかなか{沸|わ}かない。
examples.english: I want to turn up the flame and boil the water quickly, but it won't boil.

examples.japanese: {暗|くら}い{部屋|へや}の{中|なか}でろうそくに{火|ひ}をつけたら、{小|ちい}さな{火|ひ}が{静|しず}かに{揺|ゆ}れて、とても{綺麗|きれい}だった。
examples.english: When I lit a candle in the dark room, the small flame flickered quietly and it was very beautiful.

notes:
{火|ひ} is a fundamental noun for fire, flames, and heat sources.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {火|ひ}をつける: to light, ignite
- {火|ひ}を{消|け}す: to put out a fire
- {火|ひ}を{起|お}こす: to start a fire
- {火|ひ}に{気|き}をつける: to be careful with fire
- {火|ひ}の{用心|ようじん}: fire prevention

COOKING TERMS:
- {強火|つよび}: high heat
- {弱火|よわび}: low heat
- {中火|ちゅうび}: medium heat
- とろ{火|び}: simmering

COMPOUNDS:
- {火事|かじ}: fire (disaster)
- {花火|はなび}: fireworks
- {火山|かざん}: volcano
- {火曜日|かようび}: Tuesday

IDIOM:
{火|ひ}に{油|あぶら}を{注|そそ}ぐ - to add fuel to the fire (make things worse)
